text:
Anya: Pushed a new compact invite variant to Figma that focuses on density for org admins. Key changes: single-line permissions chip (opens popover), collapsed SSO control on mobile, and a 'view audit' micro-link. Figma: https://figma.com/file/efgh5678 Matt: Quick scan. The single-line perms chip is great for scanning. Main worry: the inline SSO control might be interpreted as a one-off toggle for the sent invite rather than a seat-level enforcement. Could cause accidental policy mismatches. :warning: Lex: Agree. Suggest explicit affordance: when SSO state differs from org default show a small label "Overrides org" and a tiny info icon. Also propose keyboard order: Name -> Email -> Role -> perms chip -> SSO (or details) -> Send. Samir: Accessibility points: - perms popover needs `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and focus trap when open. - avoid adding extra tab stops for collapsed mobile flows. - the yellow accent on the perms chip fails AA contrast; use a darker shade. Jia: Microcopy proposals: - Toggle: 'Require SSO' - Tooltip (hover): 'Force SSO sign-in for this invite, overrides org setting.' - Audit link text: 'View invite audit' Short and clear = better for narrow widths. design-bot: Uploaded variant 2a and accessibility notes. Linked PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/4150. Included keyboard nav prototype. Anya: Two flow questions: 1) Bulk invites: we show "3 roles" + details link instead of chips. Clicking details opens a drawer with list and per-email exceptions. 2) Audit jump: clicking 'view invite audit' should open audit panel pre-filtered by event=invite and emails query param. Matt: For mobile collapse, move SSO toggle into the details drawer to avoid clutter. Add an undo snackbar when changing SSO with message: 'SSO requirement updated for invite Undo'. Also, consider confirmation for org-level overrides if the admin lacks permission. Lex: On deep-linking audit: shallow-link to /console/audit?event=invite&email=foo@bar.com so back button behavior is preserved. Show a small loading spinner in the audit panel while filters apply. Samir: Implementation snippet for live announcement after send: ```
Invites sent. Audit entries created for 3 recipients.
``` Also add role descriptions to ARIA labels for the perms popover items. Jia: Final copy decision: 'Require SSO' for toggle, tooltip = 'Overrides org SSO for this invite', audit link = 'View invite audit'. Keep microcopy < 28 chars where possible. Anya: Action items: Lex - update Figma mobile drawer and shallow linking. Samir - add a11y checklist and example snippets to PR. Jia - finalize tooltip and toast copy. Matt - verify permission model and confirm whether confirmation modal is needed when someone changes SSO for invites. I'll add acceptance criteria + QA steps to the ticket. Thanks :thumbsup:
